name: Globtier Infotech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Globtier Infotech Limited is a managed IT and SAP support service provider based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1][2]
The company is a managed IT and SAP Support Service provider catering to SMEs and large enterprises across industries. It operates through two subsidiaries—Globtier USA, LLC and BOTGO Technologies Pvt Ltd. Its registered office is in Noida, with a Business Continuity Planning (BCP) facility in Bangalore.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.96 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 32.1%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 102 to 125 days.
